blocks.name: Forward walk
blocks.status: Assigned 2026-10-02 before any hour is sealed. Never exploration, never a backward confirmation holdout. Read only by `tools/exp012_forward.py` (and `tools/tape_coverage.py` for identities and times). Every hour passes `backfill_verify --content` and gets a sha256 line before it is read. `[2026-10-14T01, 2026-10-16T01)` is also read for features only as walk 2's buffer (DEC-021 §3); no outcome used. That read runs only after EXP-012's FINAL is written. **EXP-022 (CAP-PICK), 2026-10-08:** EXP-022 counts no hour of this row; its counted window starts at 2026-10-16T01, on walk 2. It reads this row only after EXP-012's FINAL is written, in two ways. (1) As walk-2 feature buffer, inside `[2026-10-14T01, 2026-10-16T01)` above: the creates of `[2026-10-15T00, 2026-10-16T01)` and the prints of hour 2026-10-16T00. (2) The A11 report-only October check on `[2026-10-06T00, 2026-10-16T00)`, only if a separate DEC-016 amendment registers it before 2026-10-16T00Z; it is never gate evidence. Both are disclosed in [EXP-012 Amendment 2](../EXP/EXP-012-migrate-entry-model-refreeze-prereg.md) (DEC-014(a)). Option X (EXP-022 as second owner of `[2026-10-10T00, 2026-10-16T01)`) was considered and rejected on 2026-10-08 (EXP-022 §0). **EXP-024 (H5-BOOSTFLOOR), 2026-10-08 ([DEC-023](../DEC/DEC-023-h5-family.md), [EXP-024](../EXP/EXP-024-h5-boostfloor-part1-prereg.md)):** the owner of this row is unchanged. EXP-024 is a second counted reader of `[2026-10-09T23, 2026-10-16T01)` (counted s0 window `[2026-10-10T00, 2026-10-16T00)`, its Look 1) under the DEC-023 exception, **only after EXP-012's FINAL is written** (DEC-016 Amendment 7), with its own V fetch and not the (B) files. It is disclosed in [EXP-012 Amendment 3](../EXP/EXP-012-migrate-entry-model-refreeze-prereg.md) (DEC-014(a)). **EXP-025 (C1-NF), 2026-10-09 ([DEC-025](../DEC/DEC-025-c1nf-family.md), [EXP-025](../EXP/EXP-025-c1nf-part1-prereg.md)):** the owner of this row is unchanged. EXP-025 is a counted reader, not an owner, of `[2026-10-02T15, 2026-10-16T01)`: ledger, feature and creates/market-count input before 2026-10-10T00 (October training labels only from graduations at or after 2026-10-09T00), counted decisions in `[2026-10-10T00, 2026-10-24T00)` in two looks (counted decision times: Look 1 `[2026-10-10T00, 2026-10-17T00)`, 7 UTC dates; Look 2 cumulative, 14 dates, only if Look 1 did not pass; pinned lines `EXP025_COUNT_START`, `EXP025_LOOK1_END` and `EXP025_COUNT_END` in EXP-025 section 0), **only after EXP-012's FINAL is written** (DEC-016 Amendment 8), with its own V source, opening none of the files Amendment 2 keeps closed. Disclosed in [EXP-012 Amendment 4](../EXP/EXP-012-migrate-entry-model-refreeze-prereg.md) (DEC-014(a)). The owner's OK on DEC-025 O1 and O2 (two looks) and O3 (a small live canary, only under DEC-026, to be written) was confirmed by the manager on 2026-10-09. **forward-1002ev (MiScusi job #433; DEC-016 [Amendment 9](../DEC/DEC-016-exp012-forward-on-chain-hours.md), 2026-10-09):** the event-V re-walk of `[2026-10-09T00, 2026-10-16T01)` into `/data/mal/blocks/forward-1002ev` (`--event-v`, credit cap 3,600,000), a second copy of the same hours: same owner (EXP-012), not a new block, reader or owner. It is **sealed exactly as forward-1002 is**: before EXP-012's FINAL is written only the walker, `tools/backfill_verify.py` and hour counts touch it, and **no hash-only, join or md5 run happens before the FINAL** (EXP-025's seal forbids it). After the FINAL, EXP-025 reads it directly (its P6) and EXP-024's Look 1 takes V from it through `tools/forward_v_join.py`, with `getTransaction` for the fallback list ([EXP-024 Amendment 1](../EXP/EXP-024-h5-boostfloor-part1-prereg.md)). It is not a FINAL (A) or (B) input. A separate table row for the same hours on the same host is not possible (`tools/mal_catalog.py` rejects two ranged rows that overlap on one host), so the ev copy is recorded here.

blocks.name: Forward walk 2
blocks.status: **Owner named 2026-10-08 by the [EXP-022 Part 1](../EXP/EXP-022-cap-pick-part1-prereg.md) pre-registration, before any hour of this row is sealed.** **Counted window:** `[2026-10-16T01, 2026-11-06T01)` (Option Y), set by the line `EXP022_COUNT_START: 2026-10-16T01` in EXP-022 §0, and never moved. **Reads:** EXP-022 reads outcomes only at its three sealed looks (days 7, 14, 21), with its own read tool. **Hours after the counted window** are not counted by anything and are not gate evidence, except that hour 2026-11-06T01 is read only for the exits of counted attempts. **Release:** if EXP-022 is withdrawn before counting, the owner goes back to reserved by ledger edit. Original reservation: reserved 2026-10-06 before any hour is sealed. It starts at the hour the Forward walk row above ends (`2026-10-16T01`), so no hour is in two rows. **The counted window's start and end are fixed by a pre-registration merged before the first counted hour begins in real time, and are never moved after.** Feature buffer per DEC-021 §3: 48 h read from first-walk hours `[2026-10-14T01, 2026-10-16T01)`, features only, a disclosed non-owner read; counting may start at 2026-10-16T01. A re-run of the incumbent EXP-012 on this walk would be a second EXP-012 test under DEC-014 (b) and DEC-017 §1, not a free re-read. Never exploration and never a backward confirmation holdout. Nothing reads it before an owner is named, and the owner must be named before the first hour is read. **EXP-024 (H5-BOOSTFLOOR), 2026-10-08:** the owner of this row is unchanged (EXP-022). EXP-024's Look 2 is a second counted reader of `[2026-10-16T01, 2026-11-06T01)` and reads it **only after EXP-022's read has ended** (a PASS, look 3 done or NOT_DECIDABLE, a halt, or a withdrawal). Walk 2 runs to at least 2026-11-06T02 whatever EXP-022's status. From 2026-10-16T01 to the end of EXP-022's read, no H5 trade (live or paper) is taken on, or joined to, a CAP-PICK pick. Disclosed in [EXP-022 Amendment 2](../EXP/EXP-022-cap-pick-part1-prereg.md). **EXP-025 (C1-NF), 2026-10-09:** the owner of this row is unchanged (EXP-022). EXP-025 is a **non-owner reader while EXP-022 counts** of `[2026-10-16T01, 2026-10-24T02)` (counted decisions `[2026-10-16T00, 2026-10-24T00)`, exits to 2026-10-24T01). It reads chain tape only, never a CAP-PICK outcome, and removes every CAP-PICK pick from its universe, before pass A, by the boolean `pick_oracle` (a missing or stale oracle makes its read NOT_DECIDABLE). Look 1 reads `[2026-10-16T01, 2026-10-17T02)` about 2026-10-17T03Z; Look 2, if it runs, reads to 2026-10-24T02 about 2026-10-24T03Z. Disclosed in [EXP-022 Amendment 4](../EXP/EXP-022-cap-pick-part1-prereg.md) (ledger rule 3). The owner's OK on DEC-025 O2 was confirmed by the manager on 2026-10-09.
